title: A local silent-undo run compares against the PR's base, not main
why: lint/check_silent_undo.py defaults `--upstream origin/main`, so a local run on a PR stacked on another branch compares against main and not the PR's base (lane lint-uses-pinned-tools, coordinator 02:49 CST Nov 8). Not covered by open #1677 (Retire-run cite), #1712 (CI reads the PR body) or #1726 (reason for an unread cite), by their steps' titles.
note: Fix: a local run resolves the PR's base (or the branch's upstream) and compares against it; with none found, it says which base it used. Red case first: a stacked branch whose base differs from main, where today's run reports lines main lacks. Control: a PR based on main is unchanged. Related steps: silent-undo-reads-retire-run, silent-undo-ci-body, retire-excuse-silent-refusal. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the lane. Filed 02:52 CST Nov 8. Lane session_013NEJL1Umc5vUUPV286bXnV started it (coordinator, 02:49 CST Nov 8). Sighting 10:01 CST Nov 8 (lane notes-fix-large-3, on #1706): after merging origin/main into the branch, `--upstream origin/<branch> --head HEAD --strict` went red on main's own commits the merge brought in (67a684a61 drops lines in checks.yml and ci-job-caps.md; e036b8fa7 and f89467ac3 carry a misplaced Drops-lines line); `--upstream origin/main` is rc 0. Harm: every merge from main reads red and lanes learn to push past it. The lane declined at 10:03 CST: #1869 changes only a run with no --upstream, and that run would read rc 0 here; filed apart as step silent-undo-merged-main. Sighting (lane notes-fix-large-1, session_013NEJL4DPEKRiC91yHkQV7m, 17:43 CST Nov 8; it proposed step fixcheck-undo-vs-base, folded here): its #2052 fix-check brief ran the silent-undo check only against origin/main. Lane lint runs it against the PR base and failed, because a #2052 commit reverses a hunk of #1458's d561e8e1f. The fix check passed a head that lane lint fails, which cost one lane-lint run (626 s). Scope to add: the fix-check brief template, or merge's fix-check helper, runs check_silent_undo against the PR base as well as main. Coordinator pick 17:45 CST: no widening; the #2052 brief was hand-written. The skill text fix is step ci-hygiene-undo-no-upstream, after #1869.
